summary: A potential U.S.-Iran peace deal drove a Friday equity rally, though markets wavered amid conflicting reports on timing. A deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz — possibly signed at the G7 in France this weekend — pushed WTI crude down to $84, pressuring gold and energy while lifting stocks.
tweet: Iran peace deal hopes drove stocks higher and oil lower, but the FOMC kicking off Monday keeps real rates and bond vol pinned — cross-asset sentiment stays split between relief and caution.
